name: Chesterfield County Public Schools
districtFact: CCPS publishes a traditional student calendar with grade-based opening dates and a separate staggered start for Pre-K and kindergarten.

about.title: About the CCPS Calendar
about.content: Chesterfield County Public Schools serves Chesterfield County, Virginia, and publishes its traditional student calendar on the official CCPS Calendars page. The district uses grade-based opening dates, districtwide three-hour early-release days, four grading periods, and separate opening guidance for Pre-K and kindergarten. This page focuses on dates that affect student attendance and family planning. School-specific bell times, bus schedules, athletics, performances, and other campus events should be confirmed with the student’s school.

planningTips.title: CCPS Calendar Planning Notes
content: Use the correct grade-based first day for each child in your household.
Pre-K and kindergarten families should follow the staggered attendance assignment sent by their school.
Check the school’s bell and bus schedule for exact dismissal times on three-hour early-release days.
Use the official CCPS calendar subscription when automatic district updates are important.

compareIntro: Compare first student days, last days, and major break dates across large Virginia districts. Selected districts may start on the same date but use different spring breaks and end-of-year schedules.
comparisonTitle: Chesterfield County Public Schools Calendar Compared With Other Virginia Districts

comparisonInsights.label: Opening date comparison
items: CCPS’s first grade group and students in Fairfax, Virginia Beach, and Prince William all start August 24.

comparisonInsights.label: End date comparison
items: CCPS ends 12 calendar days before Fairfax, seven days before Virginia Beach, and 13 days before Prince William.

relatedDistricts.name: Fairfax County Public Schools
relatedDistricts.comparisonNote: Fairfax’s first student day is August 24, the same date CCPS begins its staggered opening. Fairfax ends 12 days later, and its Spring Break is one week earlier.

relatedDistricts.name: Virginia Beach City Public Schools
relatedDistricts.comparisonNote: Virginia Beach’s first student day is August 24, the same date CCPS begins its staggered opening. It follows the same March 29–April 2 Spring Break and ends one week later.

relatedDistricts.name: Prince William County Public Schools
relatedDistricts.comparisonNote: Prince William’s first student day is August 24, the same date CCPS begins its staggered opening. PWCS ends 13 days later and schedules Spring Break one week earlier.
